summary: All planned implementation changes are present and validated. controls_errors.py adds WorkspaceStatus.failed to _GUIDE_ELIGIBLE_STATUSES (tuple order: monitoring_pr, failed) with updated comment referencing issue #456. controls_guide.py imports cast and _reset_failed_workspace_for_remonitor, integrates state-reset into the guide flow with conditional advance_workspace_version skip, includes state_reset in event_payload and result, and branches on add_event_with_states vs add_event. All four required new tests are present with correct assertions (test_guide_failed_workspace_with_pr_resets_for_monitor_restart, test_guide_failed_workspace_reopens_merge_candidate, test_guide_failed_workspace_without_pr_rejected, test_guide_failed_workspace_idempotency_replays). The updated test_guide_rejects_wrong_state_and_missing_pr_before_creating_operation assertion includes WorkspaceStatus.failed.value in eligible_statuses. AWF validation evidence from commit 53c6e908c: ruff check passes (no issues on changed files), ruff format --check passes, mypy reports no issues in 361 source files, pytest tests/unit/service/test_controls_lifecycle_parts/test_controls_lifecycle_guide.py -q: 16 passed, pytest tests/unit/service/test_controls_lifecycle_parts/ with coverage: 90 passed, controls_guide.py 100%, controls_errors.py 100%.
